purpose: Safe structured diagnostic field and query scope contract. Presence means emitted by the owning context, never inferred from pod names or fabricated for a join.

application_record.time: UTC RFC3339 timestamp (Go nanosecond precision; TS Date ISO precision).
application_record.level: Go uppercase DEBUG/INFO/WARN/ERROR; TS lowercase debug/info/warn/error. Normalize casing in queries.
application_record.go_only_alias: msg repeats stable event; TS does not require msg.
application_record.scope: service.instance.id is generated once per process; process.pid alone is not globally unique.

service.presence: Required on shared application records; filter environment before grouping.

process.presence: Required on shared application records; process.pid is a supplemental local identifier.

session.presence: Optional, only where trusted Session/workspace context is available. Never assume every process/Auth/TLS record has Session context.

request.presence: Optional; trusted edge-generated request ID for protected Check/backend requests. Correlation is scoped to the observed deployment and request lifetime.

external_collection_custody.presence: Attached by the collector, separate from application record fields. Prior-container custody must remain distinguishable; Pod UID is not a Session ID.
external_collection_custody.backend: No remote backend, retention or storage budget is prescribed.

proxy.owner: public edge and routing proxy deployment
proxy.access_logs: Disabled for the public edge, including Git. There is no public proxy access-field or Session join contract.
proxy.failure_mapping: Auth Check and native application TLS classify edge failures in application records. Proxy startup/control diagnostics are separate vendor output; never parse raw vendor prose as an application error tuple or publish credentials/request headers/query/body.

excluded_data: raw credentials, API keys, tickets or signed assertions
query strings, bodies, prompts, tool arguments/results or provider response content
raw exceptions, stack traces, SQL or arbitrary SDK error objects

families.emission_policy: Boot-configured threshold defaults Info. Stable owner events and approved scalar fields only. Failure tuple is semantic, independent of severity. Bounded failure windows and fail-open diagnostic sink; healthy high-frequency work quiet.
families.field_presence: Only names backed by the listed owning emitters/builders are mapped here. Shared failure/resource fields may be added by the common diagnostic sink; canonical permission alone does not imply emission.
